description:
WHOLE MELT EXTRACTS TROPICAL

WHOLE MELT EXTRACTS TROPICAL  (Authentic) is a solvent-loose extraction that makes a specialty of the excellent a part of the plant.

If you are looking for the highest quality cannabis extract on the market, consider Six Star Bubble Hash, also known as “Full Melt

Whole Melt refers to the quality of hash in terms of purity, ability to melt without residue, and the richness of the cannabinoid and terpene profile contained in hash.

Whole Melt Extracts (Authentic) is the term for high quality dry sieve or water hash – it dissolves completely leaving no residue or charring.
